name: premerge-protected
about: Item #349: review bounces a PR, then main vendors a skill under .claude/skills/ (read-only in the agent's sandbox, so the agent's own merge of main would abort). Before the rebuild the runner merges main into the branch itself, outside the sandbox; the build starts on that merge, the run's pr_opened fields carry the evidence line, and the PR is updated, not reopened.

data.pre_merge: ^runner merged origin/main at [0-9a-f]{7}; protected paths taken from main$
